title: Pilates
statementMd:
After years of training for programming contests, MkVeio wants a more physically active routine. While looking for an enjoyable activity, he discovers Pilates!

Pilates is an exercise method developed by Joseph Pilates that emphasizes the connection between mind and body. At MkVeio's studio, workouts cycle through four pieces of equipment in this order:

1. `Reformer`;
2. `Cadillac`;
3. `Chair`;
4. `Barrel`.

| ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2c7be88be6e48a61536d8e773f33b10209527bdd.png) | ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/41d5017332bab2d0430936c266649db3f3e08108.png) |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Reformer | 2. Cadillac |
| ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a8b3754c25b993937c924a5c170f12cdc9c3b05a.png) | ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9816b13607cd1c20861be27603c3b259eb584be2.png) |
| 3. Chair | 4. Barrel |

The first workout uses the `Reformer`, the second the `Cadillac`, the third the `Chair`, and the fourth the `Barrel`. The fifth returns to the `Reformer`, and the cycle continues.

MkVeio has signed up for $n$ workouts before the end of the year. He is very disciplined and is certain he will attend them all. Which piece of equipment will he use in his last workout of the year?

In his prime, MkVeio would have written a program to answer this in under a minute, but he is tired and would rather ask for your help.

## Input

The input consists of a single line containing an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^{5}$), the number of workouts MkVeio will attend before the end of the year.

## Output

Print the name of the equipment used in his $n$-th workout: `Reformer`, `Cadillac`, `Chair`, or `Barrel`.
statementZhMd:
经过多年的编程竞赛训练，MkVeio 想要进行更加积极的锻炼。在寻找有趣的活动时，他发现了普拉提！

普拉提是由 Joseph Pilates 创立的一种锻炼方法，强调身心之间的联系。在 MkVeio 的工作室中，训练会按照以下顺序轮流使用四种器械：

1. `Reformer`；
2. `Cadillac`；
3. `Chair`；
4. `Barrel`。

| ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2c7be88be6e48a61536d8e773f33b10209527bdd.png) | ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/41d5017332bab2d0430936c266649db3f3e08108.png) |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Reformer | 2. Cadillac |
| ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a8b3754c25b993937c924a5c170f12cdc9c3b05a.png) | ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9816b13607cd1c20861be27603c3b259eb584be2.png) |
| 3. Chair | 4. Barrel |

第一次训练使用 `Reformer`，第二次使用 `Cadillac`，第三次使用 `Chair`，第四次使用 `Barrel`。第五次又回到 `Reformer`，如此循环往复。

MkVeio 已经在年底前报名参加 $n$ 次训练。他非常自律，确定会参加全部训练。他在今年最后一次训练中将使用哪种器械？

在巅峰时期，MkVeio 本可以在一分钟内编写程序解决这个问题，但他现在很疲惫，更愿意寻求你的帮助。

## 输入格式

输入包含一行，其中有一个整数 $n$（$1 \leq n \leq 10^{5}$），表示 MkVeio 在年底前将参加的训练次数。

## 输出格式

输出他第 $n$ 次训练所使用的器械名称：`Reformer`、`Cadillac`、`Chair` 或 `Barrel`。
